title: PNW Components New Range Grips Line
content:
Introducing PNW Components‘ minimalist grip: the new Range grips. They feature micro-fins on top, waffling underneath, and a soft-but-structured compound for 100% cushy vibes when the trail turns to chonk…

Range Grips Quick Hits

  • Sizes: Regular, XL
  • Diameter: Regular 30mm, XL 35mm
  • MSRP: $29 USD
  • Colors: Blackout Black, Peanut Butter, Hyper Lichen, Safety Orange, Fruit Snacks, Cement Grey
  • Compound: Proprietary Thermoplastic Rubber, 25A Durometer
  • Weight: 90g Regular / 134g XL Clamp: Closed-end, single-clamp

Features

Micro Fins: The Range Grip features a micro-fin pattern that supports your hand by allowing it to sink into the upper section of the grip; this provides an ultra-supple hand feel on spicy terrain.

Waffle House: On the underside of this grip, we designed a grid pattern that your fingertips can really dig into, with a raised waffle section for that extra bite.

Durometer: The Range’s proprietary thermoplastic rubber comes in a 25A durometer. We’ve tested four or five compounds over the years and keep coming back to this one for its blend of cushiness and durability.

A Recycled Core: The plastic core on the Range Grip is constructed from 80% recycled fishing nets and other reclaimed maritime plastic.

Small Fry, Big Fry: The Range comes in two sizes. The Regular (30mm) runs thin for a supple feel that stays plugged into the trail, while the XL (35mm), favored by riders with larger hands, adds extra cushion on top of the already supple patterning.

See more at PNW Components.
